posts.name: Donald Trump
posts.text: A JOINT STATEMENT MADE BY PRESIDENT DONALD J. TRUMP AND SECRETARY GENERAL OF NATO, MARK RUTTE: President Trump and Secretary General Rutte had an outstanding meeting on Wednesday evening, at what is often referred to as the Southern White House — Mar-a-Lago. The meeting was very impactful, with the War between Russia and Ukraine, and the Conflict in Iran, being the primary subjects of discussion.
